profile.headline: Learning fast how to make learning fast 😉
profile.summary:
I'm a driven future technology and architecture leader with a proven track record of reducing entropy. I've consistently taken highly ambiguous, extraordinarily complex, and under-resourced pipe-dreams and transmuted them into clearly defined, manageably partitioned, and appropriately funded work streams driving billions in net value and guiding teams from tens to hundreds of engineers.

I'm intellectually curious and a relentless life long learner who thrives on tackling complex challenges and rapidly mastering new domains. By consistently signing up to solve the least well defined and highest urgency problems, I've established expertise that spans autonomous vehicle development. I've lead meaningful  robotics hardware and software architecture development, technical program management, compute and network systems, LiDARs, cameras, radars, audio sensors, automotive systems, and AV manufacturing NPI.

My diverse interests outside of my life as a roboticist fuel my creativity and ability to identify novel solutions to challenging problems. I'm a dancer, artist, flow performer, fabricator, programmer, student, cook, vinologist, traveler, coffee roaster, astrophysics fangirl, fashionista, gastronomist, and burner. Let's make something together.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer (Deep Learning Acceleration)
positions.description:
Focused on enabling optimized deployments of Pytorch models on edge inference hardware.
- Vendored a custom pytorch export library used by all of Aurora's models
- Developed an in house visualization tool to facilitate model quantization
- Upgraded the deep learning inference compiler / optimizer / runtime library used by all of Aurora's models
- Improved P99 runtime motion planning execution by ~25ms

positions.title: Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, Aurora Driver Architecture Team
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Co-leading the Aurora Driver Architecture team. Responsible for making, delegating, and enabling critical software architecture designs and decisions across the Aurora Driver.

positions.title: Senior Staff Technical Program Manager, Exploration Team
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description: Program Manager for Aurora's Technology Exploration team, providing technical contributions and program management support on projects from early R&D to sourcing and fleet deployment across sensors, compute, and machine learning acceleration. Focused on early stage technology evaluation, requirements development, bring up, future platform architecture development, and more.

positions.title: Staff Technical Program Manager, Exploration Team
positions.description: Program Manager for Aurora's Technology Exploration team, providing program management support on projects from early R&D to sourcing and fleet deployment across sensors, compute, and machine learning.

positions.title: Staff Technical Program Manager (TLM) - Silicon and Compute
positions.description:
Managed the silicon and future compute hardware programs at Cruise for Dune (a sensor data processing SoC) and Horta (computing SoC). Drove the initial scope, cost, sourcing, and timeline for the programs to get budget and resource approval for kickoff. Lead a task force to develop a full, cost-optimized AV architecture built around the SoCs for Origin. Worked with the future ML software lead to define bring up, development, and validation requirements, deliverables, and plans.

Managed both programs, silicon partners, and IP partners through the majority of the A0 design and validation milestones pre-tape out. Hired and managed a program manager to take over Dune starting at final validation. Continued to lead Cruise's future compute module program.

positions.title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Compute and Network
positions.description: Lead Compute and Network hardware programs at Cruise: I was the lead program manager for four generations of Compute platforms. Key work included taking a next generation compute platform project from XV through DV release, leading a high complexity and cost fleet upgrade project, planning and project framing for future compute platforms, future AV network and topology development, and supporting current product issue resolution.

positions.title: Assistant Program Engineering Manager - Autonomous Sensors
positions.description: Was responsible for planning and organizing solutions to the most challenging technical and commercial issues relating to the development and implementation of Autonomous Sensors for GM/Cruise's L2-L5 AV programs. Began by defining technical roadmaps for Radars, microphones, and HD maps and working with advanced technical teams to execute development projects ranging from early stage phenomenology studies to engineering validation of design concepts. Responsible both for vetting out new projects and ensuring that approved projects met their technical deliverables within their budget and schedule constraints. Gradually expanded my roll to cover Ultrasonic sensors, GNSS, and Cameras (visible and LWIR).

positions.title: Autonomous Vehicle Program Launch Issue Resolution Team Lead
positions.description: Autonomous Program vehicle launch issue resolution team lead for body product engineering at three GM assembly plants and component suppliers. Responsible for leading the process of identifying, root causing, containing, solving, and implementing solutions for all build issues related to lower structures, upper structures, closures, paint, fascia, mirrors, wash system, glass, exterior trim, and several new autonomous vehicle subsystems.

positions.title: CAE Engineer
positions.description: Ran structural and durability analysis for trucks, crossovers, and performance vehicles.

positions.title: Design Release Engineer
positions.description: Design release engineer for full-sized pickup truck lower structures. Lead the development of a pickup box side step for heavy duty trucks. Started the Additive Manufacturing Product Development Team at GM.

positions.title: Lead Technical Developer
positions.description: Supported the development of and co-patented a handheld hyperspectral imaging system for the automated early detection of Melanoma including designing the camera casing, circuitry, image autofocusing, and illumination systems. Wrote a HIPPA compliant GUI used to gather data with the device in a large scale multi-clinical trial. Fabricated several prototypes for use in clinical trials.

positions.title: Instrumentation Engineer Intern
positions.description: Advising campus laboratories on the design and construction of various experimental setups and using milling, lathing, laser cutting and 3D printing to manufacture components of those setups for four funding lab groups.

positions.title: Physics and Mathematics Tutor
positions.description: Tutored students from middle to graduate school on selected topics in Physics and Mathematics, including Optics, Mechanics, Relativity, Astrophysics, Electricity and Magnetism, Trigonometry and Calculus.

company.name: Columbia University Tutoring and Translating Agency

positions.title: Information Specialist for Alice! Health Promotion
positions.description: Responsible for researching information from reliable medical sources and succinctly presenting it as part of a team that answers a variety of health-related questions for the website http://goaskalice.columbia.edu.

positions.title: Physics TA
positions.description: Assisted department with setting up and conducting lab demonstrations, grading coursework, running physics recitations, composing solution sets for problems, and revising lab instructions.

positions.title: Research Assistant
positions.description: Used optical, scanning electron microscopes and FIB machining equipment to complete an independent research project on the subject of Surface Plasmon Resonance in Arrays of Nano-Apertures.

patents.title: System and method for optical detection of skin disease
patents.description: An optical system for the detection of skin disease, such as melanoma, acquires images of a lesion on a subject's skin at different wavelengths and utilizes a sweeping arm rotating about the lesion in a clock-like sweep to produce diagnostically relevant metrics and classifiers from the image data so as to enhance detection of the skin disease.

patents.title: Integrated step assembly for pickup truck box
patents.description: A cargo box for a vehicle includes a base member having a first edge portion, a second edge portion, a first side edge portion and an opposing second side edge portion. A first cross sill extends across the base member. A second cross sill extends across the base member. A side panel member is coupled to the base member along one of the first and second side edge portions. The side panel member includes an opening. A step assembly includes a first step support coupled to the first cross sill, a second step support coupled to the second cross sill and at least one step member coupled to and extending between the first step support and second step support. The step member is arranged at the opening in the side panel member. The step member is decoupled from the side panel member.
